reader.notes: The implementor's choice is recorded in docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-211.md: an 8-byte occurrence number, big-endian two's complement, no alignment. The refusal diagnostics cite §2023 clauses rather than §1985 ones, a citation matter only.

refuter.evidence: g7a (refused, exit 65): IF IV = 3 and IF IV = N on an index data item both draw COBOL2533, as §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.3 requires (only index-name/index data item pairs). g7b (refused): SET IV TO 3 draws COBOL2326 and SET N TO IV draws COBOL2326 (§1985:VI.6.23.4 GR3b/GR3c), and T-E (IV) as a subscript draws COBOL0844. g7c (g7c-001): CALL USING an index data item and PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LV USAGE INDEX in a nested program print SUB=Y BACK=E. The occurrence number passes unconverted between tables of different element size and comes back. docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-211.md documents the representation GR7 leaves to the implementor (8-byte big-endian occurrence number, no alignment). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.14.4 GR7; OK §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5; OK §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.3 (the text is in the clause); OK §1985:VI.6.23.4 GR3b.
